content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?FOX 5 San Diego's PostFOX 5 San Diego Verified accountApril 2 at 4:00 PM · Shared with PublicIt's National Burrito Day, and restaurants nationwide are celebrating with burrito BOGOs and discounts. https://fox5sandiego.com/.../national-burrito-day-2026.../All reactions:287 comments6 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Top fanRaymond Joseph AltoI went to El Pollo Loco for their BOGO burrito deal thinking I just hacked the system. I used my points to grab a drink first—felt like a financial genius for about 12 seconds—then went to place a separate order for the burritos.Boom. “Only one promo per day.”So now I’m standing there, drink in hand, looking like I just got denied a loan. What was supposed to be a quick stop turned into me spending 30 minutes trying to outsmart a chicken restaurant. I’m making new accounts, refreshing the app, acting like I’m in some kind of burrito heist movie… and still losing.At some point I had to ask myself, “What am I doing with my life right now?” Over a burrito.Between the confusing rules and the app acting like it runs on dial-up, I finally gave up, took my L, and walked out. Ended up going to Subway like a defeated man ordering a sandwich instead of chasing my burrito dreams.Burrito Day is a joke—I’m not paying $15 for a burrito, and I’m definitely not enrolling in a loyalty program obstacle course just to eat one.1wJoel BernardHappy burrito day to those false advertising ##ers at Sombreros wanting you to register your personal information (for resale) & only one $7 burrito per order/group.
